resources.string: To connect wirelessly, first select a paired iPhone.
Turn on Bluetooth in system settings.
Allow Nearby devices permission in the Permission checklist.
Allow precise location in the Permission checklist.
Allow the USB VPN connection in the Permission checklist.
Could not connect to iPhone. Export a diagnostic report in Advanced settings.
Could not prepare CarPlay. Check the installation package or export a diagnostic report.
Turn on this Android phone\'s hotspot in system settings.
Could not read the hotspot switch. Confirm it is on in system settings.
Connect to the entered network in system Wi-Fi settings.
Could not read the current Wi-Fi name. Check it in system settings.
The current Wi-Fi name differs from the entered name. Check the network or name.
The hotspot address is not available yet. Confirm this phone\'s hotspot is on.
Connect the car browser and this phone to the same network, then open the link under “%1$s” below.
The car browser may not be able to access this hotspot address. Try another address method.
The hotspot address VPN could not start. Retry or choose another method.
Start Shizuku, then return to TiPlay.
